id: title:jurajmajerik:render single metric result details in a single panel

review.posthog_relevance: Changes the presentation and caching behavior of experiment result comparisons and metrics tables, potentially affecting how cached results are identified and how users view result details.
review.reason: The chunk is dominated by snapshot hash updates and UI refactoring. P1.F1.H1 changes cached result state identification, P1.F2.H1 changes conditional rendering of result details, and P1.F3.H2 adds an optional embedded prop. These are localized, bounded changes to caching and UI presentation.
review.uncertainty: The score is assigned based on the observed code, but the actual impact on PostHog users and the reliability of the system cannot be verified without additional context. The score is not a measurement of adoption, user benefit or individual performance.

observations.limitations: This chunk is dominated by snapshot hash updates and UI refactoring. No score assigned.

observations.behavior: Snapshot hash updates for experiment result comparisons.
observations.posthog_connection: These hashes identify cached result states for experiment comparisons; changing them indicates a change in the underlying query or result, not a change in the comparison capability.

observations.behavior: Adds conditional rendering of result details and table, removing the details modal and standalone details section.
observations.posthog_connection: Allows the metrics view to optionally show a combined table and details section instead of a standalone details section, potentially changing the user experience of viewing results.

observations.behavior: Adds an optional embedded prop to the MetricsTable component, allowing it to omit its own border and sit inside a parent panel.
observations.posthog_connection: Allows the metrics table to be embedded within a parent panel, potentially changing the user experience of viewing results.
